card.title: Comfort Everyone Else
card.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've made you soup. The choir rejecting us doesn't mean you should miss dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've set a bowl for yourself too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: So you won't have to eat alone. I'll butter your bread.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sit with me. I don't want you crying in the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. But take my bread too. I can't swallow yet, and you shouldn't have to ask twice.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 makes soup after shared rejection; A3 frames A's bowl as company for B; A5 gives away bread because A cannot swallow.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 questions A's place setting, which A3 turns into care; B4 asks A to stay, and A5 accepts while enlarging the food offer.

relationship.evidence: B4 wants company and protects A from crying alone, creating a reciprocal relationship rather than feeding a punchline.

heightening.evidence: B4 brings A's tears into the open; A5 admits a stronger physical symptom while still prioritizing B.

specificity.evidence: A1 choir rejection and dinner are clear; B2 two bowls and A5 bread permit an immediately playable exchange.
